items: 【All-Weather Durability & Craftsmanship】Built with a heavy-duty metal frame featuring a triple-layer protective coating, this outdoor patio furniture set is engineered to withstand the elements. The rust-resistant frame is paired with premium handwoven wicker that resists UV rays, water, and cracking, ensuring your patio sofa maintains its look and structural integrity through wind and sun.

【Superior Comfort High-Density Foam】Unlike standard padding, this high-density foam provides firm yet comfortable support without feeling stuffy. Designed for breathability, these outdoor chairs offer a cool seating experience, making them the ideal spot for long afternoons in your garden or on the porch.

【Easy Maintenance & Olefin Fabric】This outdoor sofa features premium Olefin fabric covers known for being stain and wear-resistant. Spills and outdoor dust are no match for the removable cushion covers, which are fully machine washable. Keep your patio chairs looking fresh and inviting with minimal effort throughout the seasons.

【Flexible Modular Sectional Design】Adapt your space to your needs with a versatile patio sectional layout. This 5-piece set allows for multiple configuration options, making it easy to fit into different sized patios, balconies, or backyards.
【Easy Assembly】Assembling this outdoor patio sofa set is easy with clear instructions and all necessary tools included. For a smoother process, we recommend two people for assembly.
